HiTL bar (mayday-red reserved) + roadmap now + my-agents (GET /attention) + fleet strips

On-demand inline code + per-line pheromone heat in an agent pane (single-hue ramp, truecolor->256->16, light+dark). NOT a repo browser
Avatar runs a roadmap item end-to-end (worktree->PR->adversarial test->review->CI->merge->prune->done), pd attest-gated + HiTL-surfaced, validated on live daemon
Feel pass (swoosh <=400ms, opt-in sound, reduced-motion), Commit Mono/IBM Plex/Departure Mono, 15-persona blind-test
Typed performative + versioned tube envelope; FIPA-narrowed vocabulary mapped to Attention-Queue lanes. Done when a tube message carries performative+conversationId+delegationChain and round-trips.

Protocol-pattern registry (contract-net/supervisor-worker/critique-refine/debate+judge/blackboard/fan-out-fan-in/request-response) each with stop conditions, bound to spawn/sortie/review/pheromone. Done when a dispatch runs as a real Contract-Net cfp->bid->award.
delegationChain on actor/session (ADR-0040) + loop detection (terminate on repeated task-shape; block upward delegation). Done when a ping-pong delegation is detected+terminated in a test.

Enrich ADR-0041 commitments with task-relationship type+power factor+negotiability+renegotiation triggers+lifecycle; protocol selection from relationship type. Done when a commitment carries negotiability + renegotiates on a trigger.

Bind obligation->commitment, prohibition->Arbiter, permission->capability; per-dialogue termination (quiescence/TTL/Arbiter/HiTL). Done when a dialogue terminates on quiescence and a prohibition is Arbiter-unreachable, on the live daemon.

Wire typed performatives into the Attention Queue + living-harbor viz so each visual (firefly/laser/leaf/distress) IS its performative. Done when the harbor renders a real cfp/award/escalate/inform stream.
Ratify the North Star; re-anchor the implementation roadmap + ADRs 0046/0047 to the L0->L3 stack; mark L0 built. Done when the roadmap waves map 1:1 to L0->L3.
L1: ship ADR-0047 (typed conversation/commitments/delegation) + the Arbiter jail (custom-shell corral). Done when agents coordinate via typed performatives + a tool-allowlist jail holds.

L2 SPINE: the read-surfaces — suggestibility briefings (agent read), Attention Queue (operator read), resurrection-with-memory (successor read), discovery/pd whois index. Done when tuples/pheromones/memories are READ in >=3 surfaces.
L2: the digest/legibility-with-zoom + tokens/compaction as the digest engine; the pure-ratatui operator console (ADR-0046). Done when a swarm is legible as a zoomable digest, not a PR pile.

THE WEDGE: single-player safety+assistance+accountability as the shippable product (footgun-guards, adversarial review, maintained roadmap, thoughtful landing, HiTL). Done when a solo dev would pay for it.

L3 bridge: durable identity = role + continuity (memory/checkpoint/outcome history) -> persons with registered outcomes. Done when an agent has a continuous, checkpointed identity with an outcome ledger.
L3: reputation/Elo for agents + backends, learned-outcome routing, agentic reviews. Done when backend/agent selection uses a learned reputation score.

L3 platform: harbor federation (Alice's fleet) -> the work-for-hire + skill/agent marketplace on the bond ledger (anchor protocol). Done when two operators' fleets safely co-work + trade with reputation + escrow.

Deep-research whitepapers backing the North Star (legibility/Leviathan, economy/anchor, identity->reputation, tokens/compaction, discovery/guilds), building deep skills en route. Done when each layer has a cited paper.
Harden the pd-cutter wrapper: Seatbelt + Landlock/seccomp + egress request/byte cap + receipt + honest-limits disclosure. Done when pd-cutter confines secrets + hard-caps egress on macOS+Linux.
Secret broker: agent env holds no raw key; broker injects into the outbound call. Done when reading .env.local yields nothing useful.
Dollar-accurate metering: local CA + MITM parsing provider usage fields; fixes budget-guard self-report. Done when the cap is real USD.
The portable operator-signed outcome-record FORMAT (OCI play) + Enclave/TPM signing + transparency log. Done when any party verifies a receipt without trusting Port Daddy.

Real isolation vs the malicious case: separate UID / Virtualization.framework + pf forced egress. Done when an agent that unset HTTPS_PROXY still cannot egress/read secrets (live-tree tradeoff documented).
Per-agent network policy (LittleSnitch-style allow/deny by host) + operator prompt surface. Done when each agent's egress is scoped to named hosts.
Paid Trust tier: roll receipts up to a team policy-and-audit plane. Done when an eng lead sees every agent's signed record across the team.
Non-blocking CI gate: every PR declares its roadmap item (committed snapshot + label→human-approval fallback + loud-on-broken). Daemon is the only writer; CI reads the mirror.
Conjure operator surface: prompt → claude:cli DAG → next-gen Vello render → context-partition + contracts → multi-vendor dispatch; plus the Giant Squid Harness (ADR-0091). PR #581.
